title: ASIC Physical Design, Senior Staff Engineer
description:
**Date posted** 10/06/2026

### **Category** **Engineering****Hire Type** **Employee****Job ID** **19059****Remote Eligible** **No****Date Posted** **10/06/2026**

### **We Are** Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.

### **You Are**

You have spent years in the trenches of physical design, taking complex IP from RTL to GDS, and you know that the difference between a design that tapes out on schedule and one that slips is usually a decision you made during floorplanning or a timing path you caught in week two instead of week ten. You have seen enough 5nm and below tapeouts to know where the landmines are buried, and you are the engineer who spots them before they blow up the schedule.

You do not wait for perfect specs. When the RTL is still settling and the foundry deck has a known issue, you start floorplanning anyway because you know what matters and what can wait. You have strong opinions about ICC2 strategies, about when to push timing versus area, about which corners actually matter for signoff. You are comfortable defending those opinions in a room full of architects and verification leads, and you are equally comfortable changing your mind when the data says you should.

At Synopsys, you will be working on UCIe PHYs and testchips that define how chips connect in the next generation of systems. The designs are real, the nodes are leading edge, and the team expects you to lead, not just execute.

### **What You'll Be Doing**

* Own physical design implementation of UCIe PHY blocks and testchips from floorplanning through tapeout on 5nm and more advanced nodes
* Drive synthesis, place and route, timing closure, and physical verification using DC, PT, ICC2/FC, and ICV across multiple concurrent projects
* Work directly with verification, DFT, and IP integration teams to resolve design issues, close timing, and meet PPA targets without slipping the schedule
* Lead design reviews, present tradeoff analyses, and make real-time decisions on floorplan changes, clock tree strategies, and signoff waivers
* Pilot new physical design flows and advanced node methodologies, then document what worked and what did not for the rest of the team
* Mentor junior engineers on timing closure techniques, physical verification strategies, and how to navigate the ICC2 toolchain effectively
* Interface with foundry partners and customer engineering teams to resolve technology file issues, DRC/LVS challenges, and silicon bring-up questions

### **The Impact You Will Have**

* Deliver production-quality UCIe PHY designs that enable next-generation chip-to-chip connectivity for Synopsys customers building AI accelerators, data center processors, and high-performance compute systems
* Improve design cycle time and PPA outcomes by driving tooling and methodology improvements across the physical design flow that the entire IP team will adopt
* Handle multiple concurrent tapeouts in leading-edge technologies, ensuring Synopsys meets customer commitments and maintains its reputation for on-time silicon delivery
* Strengthen customer confidence in Synopsys IP through high-quality signoff, responsive technical engagement during integration, and designs that actually work in silicon
* Influence product roadmap decisions by surfacing design insights and PPA tradeoffs that matter to end customers during architecture and planning phases
* Contribute to how Synopsys approaches physical design for 3nm and beyond by piloting new flows, feeding lessons learned back into the methodology team, and shaping best practices
* Enable faster time-to-market for customers by delivering UCIe IP that integrates cleanly, meets timing out of the box, and requires minimal rework during SoC integration

### **What You'll Need**

* 5-15 years of hands-on experience in ASIC physical design, with demonstrated expertise in synthesis, place and route, timing closure, and physical verification
* Multiple tapeouts and signoffs in 5nm or more advanced process nodes, you have taken designs all the way to GDS and dealt with the messiness that comes with it
* Proficiency with industry-standard tools including DC, PT, ICC2/FC, and ICV, you know the commands, the flow, and the workarounds
* Proven track record working on SoC or IP tapeouts where you owned significant portions of the physical design and were accountable for signoff
* Strong understanding of FinFET technology and the physical design challenges specific to advanced nodes, including multi-patterning, electromigration, and IR drop at scale
* Experience with DFT insertion, scan chain routing, and ATPG is a strong plus, especially if you have debugged DFT-related timing or physical issues
* Exposure to UCIe, SerDes, or high-speed interface IP is valuable but not required, we care more about your physical design depth and ability to learn quickly

### **Who You Are**

* You can walk into a timing review with 500 failing paths and know within ten minutes which ones actually matter and which ones are tool artifacts or false paths
* You are comfortable making tradeoff calls under pressure, like choosing to upsize a cell and take the area hit because you know the timing margin is real and the schedule cannot slip
* You do not need someone to tell you what to do next, when floorplan is done, you move to placement, when placement converges, you start clock tree, and you flag blockers before they become emergencies
* You can explain a complex physical design issue to an architect or a customer engineer in two sentences without losing the technical nuance that matters
* You have mentored junior engineers before, not in a formal program, but because someone asked you a question and you took the time to show them the right way instead of just giving them the answer
* You are organized enough to manage three tapeouts at different stages without dropping details, and you know how to keep stakeholders informed without over-communicating

### **The Team You'll Be Part Of**

You will be part of an engineering team dedicated to implementing UCIe PHY and testchips. The team focuses on the full physical design flow, encompassing synthesis, physical design, verification, design for test, and ATPG. You will collaborate with both internal and external design teams, contributing to complex projects and driving technological innovation in advanced connectivity IP.

### **Rewards and Benefits**

We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

At Synopsys, we want talented people of every background to feel valued and supported to do their best work. Synopsys considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, military veteran status, or disability.

title: Sr Engineer, Digital Workplace Engineering
description:
**Your Future Evolves Here**

Evolent partners with health plans and providers to achieve better outcomes for people with most complex and costly health conditions. Working across specialties and primary care, we seek to connect the pieces of fragmented health care system and ensure people get the same level of care and compassion we would want for our loved ones.

Evolent employees enjoy work/life balance, the flexibility to suit their work to their lives, and autonomy they need to get things done. We believe that people do their best work when they're supported to live their best lives, and when they feel welcome to bring their whole selves to work. That's one reason why diversity and inclusion are core to our business.

Join Evolent for the mission. Stay for the culture.

**What You’ll Be Doing:**

Job Summary

This role implements, manages and continuously improves Microsoft 365 technologies, Intune Suite, Purview, Copilot and integrations with adjacent technologies. The engineer seeks to automate or eliminate repeatable tasks and reduce administrative overhead for themselves and workplace operations, including configuration variations, performance issues on endpoint devices and security vulnerabilities. The engineer also collaborates with technology vendors, product managers, IT security and legal or compliance teams to ensure alignment with company policy and applicable legislation.

This role also builds automation and agentic AI–powered workflows—writing code and configuring AI agents—to reduce manual effort and scale the impact of the digital workplace team.

This is an individual-contributor role that executes within the engineering standards, architecture and AI governance guardrails established by Lead-level engineers. The Sr Digital Workplace Engineer focuses on hands-on implementation, testing and day-to-day operation of assigned systems, automation and AI agents.

Essential Functions

* Implement, monitor and operate digital workplace technologies (endpoint hardware, software, services and SaaS tools)
* Integrate digital workplace technologies with adjacent technologies (identity, security, vulnerability management, IT service and asset management, remote access, backup, directory services, etc.)
* Ensure stability and security of digital workplace technology through effective endpoint management and timely patching
* Support security operations processes by monitoring and reporting anomalies related to devices and identities
* Actively participate in resolving high-priority outages, troubleshooting efforts and capacity/availability planning sessions
* Work on various digital workplace technology projects
* Create, publish and communicate knowledgebase articles
* Assess criticality of services and applications and automate testing of those deemed critical before patching and upgrading
* Provide IT support for issues escalated from level 1 or level 2
* Participate in the major incident management process to investigate, diagnose and remediate digital workplace technology outages
* Write and maintain scripts, integrations and automation (PowerShell, Python, or similar) that reduce manual, repetitive work across digital workplace operations
* Build, test and operate agentic AI workflows using established templates, guardrails and platforms
* Document and share reusable automation and AI agent patterns through the team knowledge base to accelerate adoption across the organization

Required Qualifications

* 7+ years managing or supporting IT systems and platforms
* 3+ years of experience implementing digital employee experience (DEX), endpoint management, analytics and automation tools
* Experience with standard IT operations frameworks (e.g., ITIL)
* Experience with scripting tools and languages (e.g., PowerShell, Bash, Python)
* Experience with configuration management, identity and access management, active directory, desktop virtualization, collaboration platforms and other cloud-based services
* Experience implementing modern management of endpoint devices
* Experience with continuous engineering or other agile methods to keep pace with frequent changes and to reduce complexity
* Ability to write technical documentation
* Demonstrated proficiency in at least one scripting/programming language (PowerShell, Python, or similar) with concrete examples of automation, integration or tooling delivered
* Working knowledge of agentic AI concepts (agents, tool/function calling, LLM integration) and experience configuring or extending agents on at least one low-code/no-code AI platform within existing organizational guardrails

Preferred Qualifications

* Natural excitement and ability to learn technologies and explain technical issues to a variety of audiences and levels
* Passionate about DEX, with an awareness of the latest digital trends
* Experience building a proof-of-concept AI agent or automation using a low-code AI agent platform
* Interest in or prior participation, as a contributor rather than a lead, in AI enablement initiatives, agentic AI pods, or similar cross-functional automation efforts

Preferred Education

* Bachelor’s degree in IT or related field.

Preferred Certifications

* Microsoft 365, Intune and related certifications

General Performance Criteria

As the **Sr Digital Workplace Engineer**, you will be required to fulfill your responsibilities while meeting the following general performance criteria for this position at this level:

**Expertise:** You research, create proof of concepts, and introduce new methods

**Communication:** You guide others through problem solving whether it is a technical issue, project impediment, or conflict

**Domain:** You guide the delivery of your team to make a positive impact on other parts of the company based on detailed knowledge of the needs of those stakeholders and how those needs are supported by your team

**System:** You own relevant segment of systems that are used regularly for the business to function and are well versed in the related KPIs

**Process:** You question the status quo in a constructive manner to find areas for the team to improve

**Influence:** You regularly make an impact to your entire team

To ensure a secure hiring process we have implemented several identity verification steps, including submission of a government issued photo ID. We conduct identity verification during interviews, and final interviews may require onsite attendance. All candidates must complete a comprehensive background check, in-person I-9 verification, and may be subject to drug screening prior to employment. The use of artificial intelligence tools during interviews is prohibited and monitored. Misrepresentation will result in immediate disqualification from consideration.

**Mandatory Requirements:**

Employees must have a high-speed broadband internet connection with a minimum speed of **50 Mbps** and the ability to set up a wired connection to their home network to ensure effective remote work. These requirements may be updated as needed by the business.

**Evolent is an equal opportunity employer and considers all qualified applicants equally without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or disability status.** **If you need reasonable accommodation to access the information provided on this website, please contact** **recruitingteam@evolent.com** **for further assistance.**

  
The expected base salary/wage range for this position is $. As part of our total compensation package, Evolent is proud to offer comprehensive benefits (including health insurance benefits) to qualifying employees. All compensation determinations are based on the skills and experience required for the position and commensurate with experience of selected individuals, which may vary above and below the stated amounts.

**Job Description:**

**Enterprise Tech Engineer - Data Engineering**

  
  

*Digital Trading Analytics | Trading Analytics & Insights (TA&I)*

  
  

At bp, our people are our most valuable asset. The Technology DS&C, People, Culture & Communications (PC&C) function fosters a diverse, inclusive culture where everybody can thrive. As we transition from an oil company to an integrated energy company, we are embarking on a major transformation to be more competitive, responsive, and customer-focused.

We’re investing in key locations such as India, Hungary, Malaysia, and Brazil, offering an exciting but challenging opportunity to shape a fast-moving PC&C function, building teams and structures and driving continuous improvement.

We’re looking for driven, ambitious enthusiasts who thrive in fast-paced environments and are passionate about people. If you're ready to build something transformative, this is the place for you.

The Global Solution Owner Automation and AI is responsible for owning the products, architecture, vendor relationships, and compliance globally.

  
  

**You will work with**

  
  

You will join Digital Trading Analytics and support the Trading Analytics & Insights (TA&I) organisation. We are a global, high-performing team that works closely with traders, trading analysts, business analysts, and engineers to turn data into useful insight for energy trading.

You will work in an Agile delivery environment using Kanban and Scrum practices. Azure DevOps is used to plan, track, and deliver work.

  
  

**About the role**

  
  

As an Enterprise Tech Engineer - Data Engineering, you will design, build, and support scalable data pipelines for business intelligence and analytics platforms. You will ensure data is accurate, timely, secure, and easy to use across systems. Your work will directly support trading operations through reliable, high-quality data products.

You will also use approved AI-enabled engineering tools responsibly to improve coding speed, quality, documentation, and problem solving. This is not an AI research role; it requires practical AI fluency and sound engineering judgement.

  
  

**What you will deliver**

  
  

* Architect, design, and implement robust data pipelines using Python, Pandas, SQL, Apache Airflow, and Databricks.

* Build and maintain ETL/ELT processes that ingest data from APIs, relational databases, event streams, and flat files.

* Develop cloud-based data solutions using AWS services such as S3, EC2, EKS, IAM, Glue, and CloudWatch where appropriate.

* Optimise, monitor, and troubleshoot pipelines for performance, cost, resilience, and scalability.

* Use distributed processing technologies such as Spark/PySpark and Delta Lake for large-scale workloads.

* Implement data quality checks, lineage, observability, and clear operational runbooks.

* Create clear data visualisations and technical communication for both technical and non-technical audiences.

* Work with multi-functional partners to translate trading and business needs into fit-for-purpose data solutions.

* Apply Agile practices, version control, code review, automated testing, and release subject area.
  

  

**AI-enabled engineering and productivity**

  
  

You will use approved AI tools to accelerate delivery while protecting company data, validating output, and retaining accountability for production decisions.

* Understand practical AI fundamentals, including how LLMs generate responses, common limitations, hallucinations, and privacy risks.

* Use coding assistants and AI tools effectively for code drafts, tests, documentation, SQL review, debugging, and knowledge discovery.

* Write clear prompts: state the goal, constraints, inputs, expected output, and acceptance checks.

* Create useful context for AI tools using relevant schemas, examples, business rules, and bounded source material without exposing critical information.

* Understand RAG fundamentals: document retrieval, grounding, citations, evaluation, and access control.

* Evaluate AI-generated work through testing, peer review, source checks, and security review before production use.

* Keep current with approved emerging AI capabilities and propose practical uses that improve productivity or data quality.
  

**What you will need to be successful**

* 3+ years of data engineering experience in an enterprise environment.

* Strong Python and Pandas skills, including HTTP/API integration (for example, Requests). Use web automation only where it is approved, lawful, and appropriate for the source.

* Advanced SQL and solid understanding of relational data modelling and databases.

* Proven ETL/ELT and pipeline design experience, including hands-on Apache Airflow.

* Hands-on Databricks and distributed processing experience; Spark/PySpark and Delta Lake are strongly preferred.

* Experience building and operating data solutions on AWS, including S3 and relevant managed data services; familiarity with IAM is expected.

* Experience with EKS is helpful where workloads run on Kubernetes.

* Experience with messaging or streaming systems such as Kafka; familiarity with event-driven data patterns is helpful.

* Solid understanding of Linux, Git, pull-request workflows, and CI/CD. Azure DevOps experience is helpful.

* Familiarity with Docker, infrastructure as code (for example Terraform, Jenkins), and secure cloud deployment practices.

* Experience with Tableau, Power BI, or similar visualisation tools.

* Understanding of secure engineering standards and documentation practices.

* Basic practical knowledge of LLMs, RAG, prompt design, context design, and safe use of AI developer tools.

* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, collaboration, and organisational skills.

* A responsible, self-motivated, adaptable approach and a genuine interest in automation.

* Experience in trading, financial services, energy, or another regulated data-intensive domain is advantageous.

* A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

### **Category** **Engineering****Hire Type** **Employee****Job ID** **19129****Remote Eligible** **No****Date Posted** **10/06/2026**

### **We Are** Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.

### **You Are**

You have spent a decade building embedded memory IP that actually ships in production silicon, not just test chips that look good in papers. Managing teams through the full arc of SRAM, register file, and TCAM development has taught you that the hardest decisions happen early, at the architecture and bit cell level, and you have learned to guide engineers toward choices that hold up through tapeout and beyond.

You think in tradeoffs. Power versus area, speed versus yield, custom circuit elegance versus compiler automation constraints. When a layout is failing timing or a bit cell is not meeting yield targets at 3nm, you do not panic or wait for more data. You pull the team together, dig into the SPICE decks, and find the path forward.

Leading engineers across circuit design, physical implementation, and characterization means you speak multiple technical languages fluently. You can review a sense amplifier schematic in the morning, debug a Perl-based compiler flow after lunch, and walk a junior engineer through FinFET variation analysis before you leave. Your team trusts you because you have done the work and because you make them better at theirs.

At Synopsys, you will lead memory IP development that powers the most advanced semiconductor designs in the world.

### **What You'll Be Doing**

* Lead a cross-functional team through the complete embedded memory development cycle, from bit cell analysis and architecture definition through circuit design, layout, verification, characterization, and model generation
* Drive SRAM, register file, TCAM, and ROM compiler development, balancing performance, power, area, and yield across advanced FinFET technology nodes
* Own schematic entry, transistor-level simulation, layout planning, and interface with CAD teams for full physical verification and timing model delivery
* Design and implement low-power, area-efficient memory circuits and architectures optimized for deep submicron and FinFET process variations
* Coordinate daily activities across your engineering team, prioritize workloads across multiple concurrent projects, and proactively address issues impacting schedule or quality
* Collaborate with internal teams and external customers to resolve technical challenges, align on solutions, and ensure memory IP meets functional and performance requirements
* Ramp quickly on existing flows, identify gaps or inefficiencies, and produce actionable work plans that drive projects to completion on aggressive timelines

### **The Impact You Will Have**

* Your team will deliver production-ready memory compilers that enable customers to build complex SoCs at the most advanced process nodes
* Architectural and circuit decisions you guide will directly affect power, performance, and area outcomes in chips used across AI, mobile, automotive, and data center applications
* Memory IP you ship will be integrated into designs at scale, affecting yield, time-to-market, and product success for Synopsys customers globally
* Process improvements and automation you implement will increase team productivity and reduce development cycle time across future memory platforms
* Engineers you mentor will grow their skills in advanced circuit design, FinFET technology, and memory compiler automation, strengthening the team's long-term capability
* Technical solutions you drive will resolve cross-discipline challenges spanning circuit design, physical implementation, characterization, and modeling
* Your ability to deliver on schedule will enable downstream teams in verification, integration, and customer engagement to execute without delay

### **What You'll Need**

* 10+ years of hands-on experience in embedded memory design, covering architecture, circuit design, physical implementation, compiler automation, characterization, and model generation
* BE/B.Tech/ME/M.Tech/MS in Electrical and Electronics Engineering
* Deep expertise in SRAM and register file architectures, including custom circuit techniques for sense amplifiers, write drivers, decoders, and bit cells
* Direct experience designing memory IP in advanced FinFET technology nodes, with strong understanding of variation-aware design, leakage management, and yield optimization
* Proficiency in scripting using Perl and Python for automation of design flows, characterization, and model generation
* Solid grounding in CMOS fundamentals, RC circuit analysis, digital design, and analog circuit basics, with practical application in memory design contexts
* Proven ability to lead engineering teams, manage multiple projects simultaneously, and deliver complex IP on schedule in a cross-site, multi-discipline environment

### **Who You Are**

* You can walk into a design review, spot the issue in a timing path or a layout bottleneck, and guide the engineer toward a fix without taking over their work
* When a project is behind schedule or facing a technical roadblock, you do not wait for escalation. You pull the right people together, frame the problem clearly, and drive to a decision
* You are comfortable saying no when a proposed solution will not scale, will not meet yield, or will create problems six months downstream, and you can explain why in terms the team understands
* Mentoring engineers is not a side task for you. You actively invest in growing your team's skills, whether that means reviewing their SPICE simulations in detail or walking them through FinFET device physics
* You communicate technical tradeoffs effectively to senior internal stakeholders and external customers, translating circuit-level complexity into clear business and performance implications
* You stay current with advances in memory design, process technology, and EDA tooling, and you bring that knowledge back to your team in practical, applicable ways

description:
**Date posted** 10/05/2026

### **Category** **Engineering****Hire Type** **Employee****Job ID** **19011****Remote Eligible** **No****Date Posted** **10/05/2026**

### **We Are** Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.

### **You Are**

You have spent years verifying IP that has to work in silicon, not just pass regression. The difference between a clean tape-out and a respin often comes down to the corner case you caught at 2 AM in a Verdi waveform, and you are the engineer who finds it before it becomes a silicon bug. You read protocol specs the way some people read novels. UFS, UniPro, MIPI M-PHY are not just acronyms to you, they are systems you understand at the transaction level, the state machine level, and the timing level. You know where the edge cases hide.

Building a UVM environment from scratch does not intimidate you. Neither does inheriting someone else's testbench and making it better. You write sequences that stress the design in ways the spec did not explicitly call out because you have learned that is where the bugs live. Coverage closure is not a checkbox exercise for you, it is a conversation with the design about what actually matters.

You do not need someone to tell you what to verify next. You read the spec, talk to the designer, look at the waveform, and figure it out. At Synopsys, you will work on high-speed interconnect IP that powers real products, and what you verify will ship.

### **What You'll Be Doing**

* Own end-to-end verification for MphyV6, UFS, and UniPro IP blocks, from test planning through coverage closure and sign-off
* Build and extend UVM testbenches in SystemVerilog, including agents, sequences, scoreboards, coverage models, and protocol checkers
* Write constrained-random and directed tests that expose corner cases, protocol violations, and timing edge conditions
* Debug complex failures using Verdi at the waveform, transaction, and protocol level, performing root-cause analysis on RTL and testbench issues
* Translate protocol specifications into executable test plans, SystemVerilog assertions, and functional coverage models
* Collaborate with design, architecture, and silicon validation teams on bug triage, ECO impact analysis, and tape-out readiness
* Mentor junior verification engineers through code reviews, debug sessions, and technical guidance on UVM best practices

### **The Impact You Will Have**

* Catch silicon bugs before tape-out, directly reducing respin risk and time-to-market for high-speed interconnect IP used across the industry
* Deliver verified, production-quality IP blocks that meet protocol compliance and performance requirements for customer integrations
* Build reusable verification infrastructure that accelerates future IP development and improves regression quality across the team
* Drive coverage closure strategies that focus verification effort where it matters, not just where it is easy to measure
* Influence design decisions early by identifying architectural risks and edge cases during specification review
* Strengthen the technical capability of the verification team through mentorship, documentation, and knowledge transfer
* Contribute to first-silicon success by ensuring verification completeness and clear handoff to validation teams

### **What You'll Need**

* Bachelor's with 5+ years or Master's with 3+ years in Electronics Engineering, Computer Engineering, or equivalent technical discipline
* Hands-on ASIC verification experience with ownership of IP or subsystem-level blocks
* Deep expertise in UVM methodology and SystemVerilog, including testbench architecture, constrained-random verification, and coverage-driven verification
* Strong working knowledge of high-speed protocol standards such as UFS, UniPro, MIPI M-PHY, PCiE, or similar interconnect protocols
* Proficiency with Verdi for waveform debug, transaction-level analysis, and protocol visualization
* Experience writing SystemVerilog assertions and building functional and code coverage models
* Demonstrated ability to work independently, drive verification closure, and communicate technical issues clearly across teams

### **Who You Are**

* You can look at a failing regression, open Verdi, and within an hour tell the team whether it is an RTL bug, a testbench race, or a protocol misunderstanding
* You push back when a test plan is too vague or a coverage metric does not actually measure the risk it claims to address
* Ambiguity does not stop you. When the spec is unclear or the design is still evolving, you make reasonable assumptions, document them, and keep moving
* You explain complex protocol behavior to designers and architects in a way that gets to the issue without requiring them to read 200 pages of specification
* Mentoring junior engineers is not a distraction for you. You see it as part of building a team that can verify harder problems faster
* You care about the quality of your testbench code as much as you care about the quality of the RTL you are verifying

title: R&D Engineer, IP Quality
description:
**Date posted** 09/15/2026

### **Category** **Engineering****Hire Type** **Employee****Job ID** **18521****Remote Eligible** **No****Date Posted** **09/15/2026**

  
  

### **We Are**

Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.

  
  

### **You Are**

You are someone who gets a quiet satisfaction from finding the bug no one else caught, from writing a script that s the team three hours a week, from seeing a pattern in test data that points to something fixable. You do not just run tests, you think about what they mean and what they are missing. You know that quality is not something you inspect in at the end, it is something you build into the process from the start.

  
  

Scripting is not a chore for you. Whether it is Python or Tcl, you see automation as a way to make repetitive work disappear so you can focus on the problems that actually need a human. You are comfortable sitting with a dataset, pulling it apart, and surfacing the insight that changes how the team approaches the next release cycle.

  
  

You are early in your career but already understand that good engineering is about details, follow-through, and clear communication. You ask questions when something does not make sense. You document what you learn. You show up ready to contribute, not just observe. At Synopsys, you will work on Embedded Memory IP that powers the devices people use every day, and the quality work you do here will matter.

  
  

### **What You'll Be Doing**

* Coordinate kickoff and release meetings with cross-functional teams to ensure compliance and process alignment throughout development and verification.
* Run regression test suites on Embedded Memory IP releases and track results across validation cycles.
* Analyze test data to surface trends, flag anomalies, and identify root causes of failures or quality gaps.
* Write and maintain Python and Tcl automation scripts that streamline testing, reporting, and compliance workflows.
* Document test outcomes, process gaps, and improvement recommendations in clear, actionable formats.
* Support the team in refining Quality Management System processes based on real-world validation feedback.
  

  

### **The Impact You Will Have**

* Deliver zero-defect Embedded Memory IP to customers by catching issues before they reach production.
* Enable faster, more reliable releases through automation that reduces manual testing overhead.
* Surface data-driven insights that help engineering teams make better decisions about where to focus next.
* Strengthen the Quality Management System so every release cycle is more efficient than the last.
* Support the development of IP on advanced technology nodes that power AI, mobile, and smart device applications.
* Build a foundation of quality practices that scale as the product portfolio grows.
  

  

### **What You'll Need**

* Bachelor's degree in Electronics and Communication Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field.
* 0 to 2 years of experience in validation, testing, quality assurance, or a related engineering role.
* Working knowledge of Python or Tcl for scripting and automation.
* Ability to analyze data, identify patterns, and communicate findings clearly.
* Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail, you notice when something is off and you dig into why.
  

  

### **Who You Are**

* You can take a messy test log, pull out what matters, and explain it to someone who was not in the room.
* You are comfortable working across teams, coordinating meetings, and making sure people have what they need to stay on track.
* You do not wait to be told what to automate, you see repetitive work and you build a script for it.
* You are adaptable and do not get thrown when priorities shift or requirements change mid-cycle.
* You care about doing things right, not just fast, and you are willing to ask for clarity when the path forward is not obvious.
  

  

### **The Team You'll Be Part Of**

You will be part of a highly skilled, dynamic team focused on defining and executing processes and methodology for Quality Management of Embedded Memories. You will work closely with cross-functional teams and are committed to continuous learning and improvement, fostering an environment where creativity and technical excellence thrive.

  
  

### **Rewards and Benefits**

We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

At Synopsys, we want talented people of every background to feel valued and supported to do their best work. Synopsys considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, military veteran status, or disability.

title: Cloud Platform Architect
description:
**Your Future Evolves Here**

Evolent partners with health plans and providers to achieve better outcomes for people with most complex and costly health conditions. Working across specialties and primary care, we seek to connect the pieces of fragmented health care system and ensure people get the same level of care and compassion we would want for our loved ones.

Evolent employees enjoy work/life balance, the flexibility to suit their work to their lives, and autonomy they need to get things done. We believe that people do their best work when they're supported to live their best lives, and when they feel welcome to bring their whole selves to work. That's one reason why diversity and inclusion are core to our business.

Join Evolent for the mission. Stay for the culture.

**What You’ll Be Doing:**

**Department:** Platform Engineering & Operations (PEO)Function / Team Platform Architecture

**Reports To:** Director, Platform Architecture

**Location / Work Arrangement:** Remote / Work at Home

**Employment Type:** Full-time

**Date / Version:** 2026-09 / v1 (standard template)

**Role Overview**
=================

As a Platform Architect in Evolent's Platform Engineering & Operations (PEO) organization, you will be responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining the cloud and infrastructure platforms that Evolent's applications run on. This role involves strategic thinking to solve high impactful organizational issues with expertise in major cloud platforms, specifically Microsoft Azure.

**Why This Role Matters**
=========================

Evolent is transforming how it builds and operates infrastructure under a refreshed Platform Engineering & Operations operating model, grounded in four principles: Architecture First, Automation by Default, Reliability is a Shared Responsibility and Golden Paths Over Custom Solutions. You will turn approved designs into provisioned, automated, and documented platforms, and you will do it transparently, through formal handoffs, Office Hours reviews, and documentation your peers can actually rely on.

**Agentic AI**: Platform Engineering is moving toward agentic AI as a standard part of how the organization works. As agentic AI transforms the way we work, we expect our engineers to be at the forefront of that change, designing and building intelligent solutions rather than simply consuming them. This builder mentality is a core attribute we assess from the first conversation.

**What You'll Be Doing**
========================

* Provision and change infrastructure exclusively as code, so that every environment is reproducible, reviewable, and free of manual drift.
* Reverse engineer the applications and infrastructure you inherit: trace dependencies, integrations, and data flows end to end until you can explain how a system actually works.
* Design and build agentic AI solutions for platform, delivery, and operations work: identify the toil worth automating, then build, evaluate, and harden the agent that removes it.
* Build security and compliance into the delivery path: least-privilege access, secrets handling, policy-as-code guardrails, and audit evidence produced by design rather than assembled under deadline.

*Scope note: This role works inside one PEO function and partners across the others. Platform Architecture defines and approves standards, DevOps provisions and delivers, Site Reliability Engineering operates production, Platform Enablement & Automation builds golden paths and guardrails, Database Administration owns data platforms, and Cloud Network Services owns the foundational cloud fabric and network. Hiring manager: add any boundary specific to your team here.*

**What You'll Need to Be Successful**
=====================================

* Demonstrates humility, openness to feedback, and a team-first mindset.
* Comfortable with a high level of transparency, surfacing risks and mistakes early.
* Ability to create high-quality technical diagrams and documentation.
* Deep knowledge of agentic AI concepts: agents and tool use, orchestration, context and retrieval, evaluation, guardrails, and the limits of each. This is one of the most important requirements for the role, because every person in Platform Engineering & Operations is expected to become a builder of agentic AI solutions rather than only a user of them.
* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills with the ability to communicate effectively with technical and business stakeholders.
* Demonstrated ability to reverse engineer application architecture: take an unfamiliar application and the infrastructure under it, trace its components, dependencies, and data flows.
* Working fluency in Infrastructure as Code and Configuration as Code. Terraform and Ansible are Evolent's standard tooling.

**Domain Expertise — Platform Architecture**
============================================

* Lead the design and implementation of scalable, secure, and resilient workloads on the Azure platform
* Maintain overall cloud organization and standards such as the Azure Landing Zone architecture, the Azure Well Architected Framework, and Enterprise Policy Governance.
* Implement cloud security measures and controls set by Senior and Principal team members from regulatory compliance frameworks such as HITRUST & CIS.
* Proficiency with tools such as Azure Portal/CLI, Azure Advisor, Azure Policy, Azure Resource Graph, and VS Code.
* Analyze existing cloud architectures and recommend optimizations for cost efficiency, scalability, resiliency, and performance.

**Nice to Have (Preferred)**
============================

* Experience applying agentic AI concepts, whether through professional experience, personal projects, academic work, or other relevant initiatives: what it does, the choices you made, what failed, and what you would change.
* Proficiency in a scripting or programming language used for automation and tooling, such as Python, Go, PowerShell, C#, or Bash.
* Experience in a regulated environment, for example healthcare and HIPAA, SOC 2, or similar.

**Certifications (Preferred)**
==============================

* Relevant Azure certifications preferred, for example AZ-104 or AZ-305, AI-500 or AB-100
* ISC2 Certified in Cybersecurity

**Academic Qualification**
==========================

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education, training, and experience.

To ensure a secure hiring process we have implemented several identity verification steps, including submission of a government issued photo ID. We conduct identity verification during interviews, and final interviews may require onsite attendance. All candidates must complete a comprehensive background check, in-person I-9 verification, and may be subject to drug screening prior to employment. The use of artificial intelligence tools during interviews is prohibited and monitored. Misrepresentation will result in immediate disqualification from consideration.

**Mandatory Requirements:**

Employees must have a high-speed broadband internet connection with a minimum speed of **50 Mbps** and the ability to set up a wired connection to their home network to ensure effective remote work. These requirements may be updated as needed by the business.

**Evolent is an equal opportunity employer and considers all qualified applicants equally without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or disability status.** **If you need reasonable accommodation to access the information provided on this website, please contact** **recruitingteam@evolent.com** **for further assistance.**

As part of our total compensation package, Evolent is proud to offer comprehensive benefits (including health insurance benefits) to qualifying employees. All compensation determinations are based on the skills and experience required for the position and commensurate with experience of selected individuals, which may vary above and below the stated amounts.

description:

Our robust product portfolio includes world-leading MCUs, SoCs, analog and power products, plus Winning Combination solutions that curate these complementary products. We are a key supplier to the world’s leading manufacturers of electronics you rely on every day; you may not see our products, but they are all around you.

As a global team, our employees actively embody the Renesas Culture, our guiding principles based on five key elements: Transparent, Agile, Global, Innovative, and Entrepreneurial. Renesas believes in, and has a commitment to, diversity and inclusion, with initiatives and a leadership team dedicated to its resources and values.  **Job Description**

Lead the architecture and provide guidance for technical execution of photonic integrated circuit (PIC) and electronic integrated circuit (EIC) platforms, delivering pilot projects that prove technology feasibility, system value, manufacturability, and a path to productization.

**Job Summary**

* Own end-to-end architecture for silicon photonics solutions that combine PICs, EICs, advanced packaging, optical interfaces, firmware, and system-level control.
* Translate product, customer, and business requirements into system architecture, technical specifications, performance budgets, interfaces, technology choices, and executable pilot plans.
* Define and deliver pilot demonstrators that de-risk critical capabilities such as optical I/O, co-packaged optics, chiplet connectivity, sensing, or other strategic silicon-photonics use cases.
* Provide technical leadership across concept, modeling, design, tape-out, packaging, bring-up, characterization, and proof-of-value demonstrations.
* Build a pragmatic roadmap from prototype to scalable products, including platform reuse, ecosystem choices, and make/buy/partner recommendations
* Define system requirements and partition functionality across PIC, EIC, package, substrate/interposer, optics, firmware, and host interfaces
* Create link and system budgets covering optical loss, laser power, modulation, receiver sensitivity, signal integrity, power, thermal behavior, latency, reliability, and testability
* Guide PIC architecture and design tradeoffs involving modulators, photodetectors, waveguides, couplers, filters, splitters, monitors, and calibration structures
* Guide EIC architecture and tradeoffs involving laser/modulator drivers, TIAs, clocking/CDR, SerDes interfaces, ADC/DAC or control loops, telemetry, power management, and digital control
* Lead architecture reviews and design reviews; establish interface specifications, verification plans, risk registers, success criteria, and measurable pilot exit gates.
* Coordinate foundries, OSAT/advanced-packaging partners, IP vendors, EDA/tool providers, laboratories, and university or ecosystem collaborators
* Partner with product, software, design, verification, packaging, test, reliability, manufacturing, and business teams to achieve performance, cost, schedule, and quality objectives
* Mentor architects and engineers, raise technical capability across the organization, and communicate recommendations clearly to senior technical and business leaders.

Contribute to invention disclosures, patents, technical publications, supplier assessments, and longer-term silicon-photonics technology strategy

 **Qualifications**  

* BTech/BE, MTech/ME, or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Photonics, Applied Physics, Computer Engineering, or a related field with hardware engineering experience of 15+ years
* Deep expertise in silicon photonics, optical communications, photonic integration, electro-optic systems, or closely related semiconductor technologies
* Proven experience architecting or delivering at least one complex PIC/EIC, optical transceiver, optical I/O, co-packaged optics, or integrated photonics program from concept through silicon or hardware validation.
* Strong understanding of PIC building blocks and passive/active optical behavior, supported by modeling, simulation, laboratory characterization, and data-driven design tradeoffs.
* Strong understanding of high-speed mixed-signal EIC functions and the electrical/optical interfaces between drivers, modulators, photodetectors, TIAs, clocking, control, and digital logic.
* Working knowledge of semiconductor process technologies, PDK-based design, DFM, process variation, yield, reliability, thermal constraints, packaging, assembly, and production test.
* Ability to use or direct use of photonic, electromagnetic, circuit, link, thermal, and signal-integrity simulation tools; ability to correlate models with measured results.
* Excellent problem-solving, written and verbal communication, technical influence, teamwork, attention to detail, and commitment to execution quality.
* Prior experience with technologies and standards relevant to high-speed links, such as Ethernet/IEEE, OIF CEI, PCIe/CXL connectivity, SerDes, FEC, and system management interfaces
* Any of following experience would be a plus : Co-packaged optics, optical I/O chiplets, pluggable optical modules, data-center interconnect, AI/HPC fabrics, or high-speed Ethernet applications, Advanced packaging such as 2.5D/3D integration, interposers, hybrid bonding, flip-chip, fiber attach, laser integration, thermal solutions, and package-level optical/electrical co-design

  
**Additional Information**

Renesas is an embedded semiconductor solution provider driven by its Purpose ‘**To Make Our Lives Easier**.’ As the industry’s leading expert in embedded processing with unmatched quality and system-level know-how, we have evolved to provide scalable and comprehensive semiconductor solutions for automotive, industrial, infrastructure, and IoT industries based on the broadest product portfolio, including High Performance Computing, Embedded Processing, Analog & Connectivity, and Power.  
  
With a diverse team of over 21,000 professionals in more than 30 countries, we continue to expand our boundaries to offer enhanced user experiences through digitalization and usher into a new era of innovation. We design and develop sustainable, power-efficient solutions today that help people and communities thrive tomorrow, ‘**To Make Our Lives Easier**.’  
  
At Renesas, you can:

* **Make a real impact** by developing innovative products and solutions to meet our global customers' evolving needs and help make people’s lives easier, safe and secure.
* **Maximize your performance and wellbeing** in our flexible and inclusive work environment. Our people-first culture and global support system, including the remote work option and Employee Resource Groups, will help you excel from the first day.

Are you ready to own your success and make your mark?

Join Renesas. Let’s **Shape the Future** together.

### **Category** **Engineering****Hire Type** **Employee****Job ID** **19009****Remote Eligible** **No****Date Posted** **10/04/2026**

**We Are**
  
Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.

**You Are**  
You have spent years verifying IP that has to work in real silicon, not just pass regression. You know that closing coverage is not about hitting a number, it is about understanding what you have not tested yet and why that matters. Protocol specs do not intimidate you. You read them, translate them into test plans, and build environments that catch the corner cases three months before tapeout.
  
You are the person design teams come to when a regression fails at 3 a.m. and no one can figure out why. You open Verdi, trace the transactions, correlate protocol behavior with RTL state, and find the root cause while others are still guessing. UVM is a tool you use well, not a checkbox you tick. You write clean agents, extend sequences without breaking existing tests, and build scoreboards that actually catch bugs.
  
Mentoring matters to you. When a junior engineer gets stuck on a constrained-random failure, you do not just fix it, you show them how to think through it. You communicate clearly across teams, whether you are explaining a coverage gap to an architect or walking a design lead through a protocol violation. At Synopsys, you will work on high-speed interconnect IP that powers the next generation of AI and compute systems, and what you verify will ship.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**

* Own end-to-end verification of UCIe, PCIe, or DDR IP blocks, from test planning and environment bring-up through coverage closure and sign-off
* Build and extend UVM testbenches in SystemVerilog, including agents, sequencers, scoreboards, coverage models, and protocol checkers
* Write directed and constrained-random tests that stress protocol compliance, corner cases, and multi-layer interactions
* Debug complex RTL and testbench failures using Synopsys Verdi, including waveform analysis, protocol trace, and transaction-level debug
* Translate protocol specifications into executable test plans, assertions (SVA), and functional coverage models that map to real silicon risk
* Collaborate with design, architecture, and silicon validation teams on bug triage, ECO impact analysis, and bring-up readiness
* Mentor verification engineers on UVM methodology, debug techniques, and protocol understanding, and contribute to design and verification reviews

**The Impact You Will Have**

* You will close coverage gaps and catch protocol violations that prevent costly respins and silicon failures

* Your testbenches will become the foundation for future IP releases, reused and extended across product generations
* Design teams will ship with confidence because your verification caught the issues that matter before tapeout
* Junior engineers will level up faster because you showed them how to debug like a senior engineer, not just run regressions
* Cross-functional teams will make better decisions because you explained the verification risk clearly and early
* Silicon validation will spend less time debugging because your pre-silicon verification was thorough and well-documented
* The IP you verify will enable high-speed interconnects in AI accelerators, data center chips, and next-generation compute platforms used by customers worldwide
  

  

**What You'll Need**

* 7+ years of hands-on ASIC or SoC design verification experience, with at least 3 years on protocol-heavy IP
* Deep working knowledge of at least one high-speed protocol: PCIe, UCIe, or DDR, with the ability to read specs and build compliant testbenches
* Strong UVM methodology experience, including building agents, writing constrained-random sequences, implementing scoreboards, and closing functional coverage
* Solid SystemVerilog skills, including object-oriented programming, constrained-random stimulus generation, and SystemVerilog Assertions (SVA)
* Proven ability to debug complex failures using Synopsys Verdi or equivalent tools (FSDB, protocol analyzers, transaction-level debug)
* Experience with industry simulators such as VCS, Xcelium, or Questa, and familiarity with regression and coverage tools like URG
* B.Tech or M.Tech in Electronics, VLSI, Electrical Engineering, or related discipline; working knowledge of a second protocol (PCIe, UCIe, DDR, CXL) is a strong plus
  

  

**Who You Are**

* You can open a 500-page protocol spec, find the state machine that matters, and turn it into a test plan and coverage model within a week

* When a regression fails intermittently, you do not rerun it and hope, you reproduce it, trace it in Verdi, and document the root cause for the design team
* You write UVM code that other engineers can read and extend six months later without asking you what it does
* You push back when a test plan is too shallow or a coverage model misses a critical scenario, and you do it in a way that moves the conversation forward
* You can explain a protocol violation to a design engineer in two sentences, then walk an architect through the same issue at the transaction level without losing the thread
* You treat verification like a product: your environments are maintainable, your tests are reusable, and your documentation helps the next person who touches your code

You have spent years at the intersection of digital and analog verification, and you know that the hardest part of any SerDes project is not just proving the logic works, but proving it works when the analog world throws noise, jitter, and timing chaos at it. You think in test plans, not test cases. You understand that a good verification strategy catches the corner case at block level, not during customer bring-up six months later.

Leading a team is not new to you. You have been the person who turns a group of talented engineers into a unit that ships on time without cutting corners. You know when to dive into a waveform yourself and when to step back and let your team own the debug. You have debugged enough mixed-signal simulations to know that the answer is usually hiding in the handoff between domains, and you are comfortable living in that space.

High-speed interfaces like PCIe, Ethernet, and USB3.1 are not buzzwords to you, they are protocols you have verified, debugged, and shipped. You ask the right questions during architecture reviews because you have seen what happens when assumptions go unchecked. At Synopsys, you will lead verification for SerDes IP that powers the chips inside everything from data centers to autonomous vehicles.

* Lead a verification team working on current and next-generation SerDes products, setting direction, reviewing test plans, and ensuring coverage closure across digital and mixed-signal domains
* Modify and extend existing UVM and VMM SystemVerilog testbenches to co-simulate mixed-signal designs, bridging digital logic with analog models in tools like AMS Designer or Xcelium
* Analyze and verify high-speed SerDes functionality including clock data recovery, equalization, and link training across protocols like PCIe Gen5/6, 400G Ethernet, and USB3.1
* Define verification test plans with clear coverage goals, track progress against milestones, and drive closure on functional, code, and assertion coverage
* Debug simulation failures that span both analog waveforms and digital logic, working with mixed-signal engineers to isolate root cause and validate fixes
* Manage customer escalations on verification quality, silicon bugs, or testbench issues, and lead pre-sales technical discussions to support customer evaluations and design wins
  

  

### **The Impact You Will Have**

* Ensure SerDes IP used in data centers, automotive, and AI infrastructure ships with the quality and performance customers depend on
* Drive verification methodology improvements that reduce simulation time, increase coverage efficiency, and catch bugs earlier in the design cycle
* Build and mentor a verification team that delivers consistently, owns their work, and raises the bar on quality with every tapeout
* Shape the verification strategy for next-generation SerDes products, influencing architecture decisions before RTL is written
* Reduce customer-found issues by tightening verification rigor and improving handoff quality between digital, analog, and system teams
* Contribute to Synopsys IP leadership by ensuring our SerDes portfolio remains best-in-class for performance, reliability, and time-to-market
  

  

### **What You'll Need**

* MTech or BTech with 15+ years of hands-on verification experience in ASIC development, with significant time spent on mixed-signal or SerDes designs
* Deep knowledge of the full ASIC development flow from architecture specification through digital design, verification, physical implementation, and hardware bring-up

* Experience debugging at the boundary between digital logic and analog circuits, including familiarity with reading SPICE netlists, interpreting analog waveforms, and understanding signal integrity concepts is a strong plus
  

  

### **Who You Are**

* You can walk into a design review, ask three questions, and identify the verification risk everyone else missed because you have seen that failure mode before
* You lead by example, you will debug a tough simulation failure alongside your team at 9pm if that is what it takes, but you also know when to delegate and trust your engineers to own the solution

### **Category** **Engineering****Hire Type** **Employee****Job ID** **18643****Remote Eligible** **No****Date Posted** **10/04/2026**

**We Are**
  
Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.

  

**You Are**  
You have spent years building verification environments that have to catch the bugs no one else saw coming, the corner cases that only show up when three protocols collide and a timing edge goes the wrong way. You know that a test plan is only as good as the bugs it finds, and you have learned to think like the design, like the system integrator, and like the customer all at once.
  
  
You are the engineer who sees a coverage hole at 95% and knows exactly which scenario is missing. Writing assertions is not a checkbox exercise for you, it is how you encode your understanding of what should never happen. You have debugged enough waveforms to know when something smells wrong three layers deeper than the symptom.
  
  
Leading a verification effort means more than running regressions. You set the strategy, you review the test plans your team writes, and you make the call on what gets verified to what depth. You work directly with RTL designers and architects, not to rubber-stamp their work but to push back when the intent is unclear or the interface is going to be painful to verify.
  
  
At Synopsys, you will work on DesignWare IP that ships into real products. The verification environments you build will be used across product generations, and the bugs you catch will never make it to silicon.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**  

* Build and evolve SystemVerilog/UVM verification environments for DesignWare synthesizable IP cores, ensuring they scale across multiple product generations and configurations
* Define comprehensive test plans that cover corner cases, protocol compliance, and system-level interactions for serial interface protocols and memory controllers, including DDR and LPDDR where applicable
* Write and debug complex testbenches, checkers, and assertions that catch real bugs in critical PHY blocks and interface logic
* Develop software requirements for the PHY that scale across various configurations and use cases
* Own verification closure for multiple critical blocks within DDR PHYs, including functional coverage, code coverage, and formal signoff
* Collaborate directly with RTL designers, digital architects, and circuit teams to align verification scope with design intent and surface issues early in the design cycle
* Manage regression infrastructure and work with the infra team to optimize verification cycles, debug failures, and keep the environment reliable

  
**The Impact You Will Have**  

* Your verification environments will catch critical bugs before tapeout, directly affecting the quality and time-to-market of DesignWare IP used across the semiconductor industry
* The test plans you define and review will set the verification standard for the team, ensuring consistent coverage and reducing escapes
* Your coverage-driven approach will surface gaps that others miss, leading to more robust IP and fewer silicon respins
* The assertions and checkers you write will become reusable verification IP, accelerating future projects and raising the quality bar
* Your collaboration with RTL and architecture teams will shape design decisions early, making designs easier to verify and more reliable in the field
* The regression strategies you implement will directly improve team productivity and reduce verification cycle time
* Your ownership of critical PHY blocks will ensure that high-stakes features meet functional and performance requirements on schedule

  
**What You'll Need**
  

* Bachelor's or Master's in Electrical Engineering or Electronics and Communication Engineering with 4+ years of hands-on verification experience
* Proven track record leading verification teams through IP project delivery, including planning, execution, and signoff
* Strong experience developing SystemVerilog/UVM testbenches from scratch and evolving them as designs grow in complexity
* Deep expertise writing test plans, implementing checkers, and building assertions that catch real bugs, not just toggle coverage
* Proficiency extracting and interpreting functional coverage and code coverage metrics, and using those insights to drive verification closure
* Experience verifying serial interface protocols and working through IP design and verification processes, knowledge of DDR or LPDDR protocols is a strong plus
* Demonstrated ability to own end-to-end verification deliverables, including metric closure and formal review signoff, experience with AI-assisted verification tools is a plus

  
**Who You Are**  

* You can walk into a coverage review, spot the gap in the test plan, and articulate exactly what scenario is missing and why it matters
* You write assertions that encode real design intent, not just the obvious cases, and you know the difference between a checker that catches bugs and one that just makes noise
* You are comfortable leading technical discussions with RTL designers and architects, pushing back when verification scope is unclear or the interface is going to create downstream pain
* You manage multiple verification efforts in parallel without losing track of what is at risk, what is on schedule, and what needs attention today
* You debug with purpose, you do not just stare at waveforms hoping for insight, you form hypotheses, test them, and move systematically toward root cause
* You treat verification infrastructure as a product, you care about regression efficiency, debug turnaround time, and whether your environment is actually usable by the rest of the team

title: Principal ASIC Digital Design Engineer (Verification)
description:
**Date posted** 10/04/2026

### **Category** **Engineering****Hire Type** **Employee****Job ID** **18921****Remote Eligible** **No****Date Posted** **10/04/2026**

**We Are**  
Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.
  
  
**You Are**
  
You have spent over a decade in verification, and you have learned that the difference between a verification flow that works and one that collapses under pressure is usually a decision made at the architecture stage. You are the engineer who catches that decision before it becomes technical debt. You think in systems, not scripts. You know that building verification infrastructure is not about assembling tools, it is about creating an environment where teams can move fast without breaking things.
  
  
You have built verification environments from scratch using VCS, Verdi, VMS Execution Manager, and UVM, and you know where each tool shines and where it does not.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**  

* Architect and implement unified verification flows for Synopsys digital IP products using VCS, Verdi, VMS Execution Manager, Verdi Planner (HVP), and VIPs
* Build scalable verification infrastructure from the ground up, designing environments that support complex IP and SoC projects across global teams
* Define, document, and propagate verification methodologies and best practices that become the standard across Synopsys digital IP projects
* Lead and mentor verification engineers, providing technical guidance on UVM, SystemVerilog, flow optimization, and debugging strategies
* Drive technical initiatives independently, managing high-impact assignments from concept through deployment and adoption
* Collaborate with EDA tool development teams to influence product roadmaps, provide feedback, and optimize verification workflows for real-world use cases
* Troubleshoot and refine verification processes for internal teams and customers, diagnosing flow bottlenecks and delivering solutions that stick

  
**The Impact You Will Have**  

* Establish verification methodology standards that accelerate time-to-market for Synopsys digital IP and SoC products
* Enable global verification teams to deliver higher quality results faster by providing robust, reusable flows and infrastructure
* Shape the verification strategy for next-generation Synopsys IP offerings, directly influencing product quality and customer satisfaction
* Reduce verification cycle time and resource overhead across multiple projects by standardizing tooling and best practices
* Develop the next generation of verification engineers at Synopsys, building a culture of technical excellence and continuous learning
* Influence the evolution of Synopsys EDA tools by providing critical, field-tested feedback to product teams
* Strengthen Synopsys' leadership position in semiconductor verification by driving adoption of cutting-edge methodologies across the organization

  
**What You'll Need**
  

* 10+ years of hands-on experience in IP or SoC verification, with a proven track record of leading technical initiatives and delivering complex verification environments
* Deep expertise with Synopsys verification tools including VCS, Verdi, VMS Execution Manager, Verdi Planner (HVP), and Verification IP (VIP)
* Strong programming and scripting skills in SystemVerilog, UVM, Tcl, and Python for automation and flow development
* Demonstrated ability to architect verification flows and infrastructure for complex digital designs, from initial concept to production deployment
* Bachelor's degree in Electronics, Electrical, or Computer Engineering; advanced degrees are a plus
* Experience managing multiple technical projects independently, balancing priorities and delivering high-quality results on schedule
* Ability to document and communicate technical methodologies clearly across global, cross-functional teams

  
**Who You Are**  

* You can explain a complex verification tradeoff to a product manager in two sentences without losing the nuance, and then turn around and debug a UVM testbench with a junior engineer
* You take ownership of problems that do not have clear owners, and you see them through to resolution even when it means coordinating across time zones and teams
* You push back when a methodology does not make sense for the use case, and you do it with data and a better alternative, not just criticism
* You are organized enough to manage five verification projects at once and strategic enough to know which one needs your attention today
* You teach by showing, not just telling, and you measure your success by how much your team grows, not just what you deliver personally
* You stay current with verification trends and tools, and you bring new ideas to the table backed by practical understanding of what will actually work in production

  
**The Team You'll Be Part Of**  
You will be a core member of the newly established Digital IP Verification Methodology (COE) team, a group of forward-thinking engineers dedicated to advancing verification excellence at Synopsys. The team collaborates across global sites, driving innovation in methodology, tool integration, and best practices. Together, you will shape the future of digital IP verification, enabling Synopsys and its customers to deliver world-class silicon solutions

At Synopsys, we want talented people of every background to feel valued and supported to do their best work. Synopsys considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, military veteran status, or disability.
